maddeler.e:
أحرنفز (form IIIq)
# أَحْرَنْفِزُ (ʔaḥranfizu) /ʔaħ.ran.fi.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# أَحْرَنْفِزَ (ʔaḥranfiza) /ʔaħ.ran.fi.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
# أَحْرَنْفِزْ (ʔaḥranfiz) /ʔaħ.ran.fiz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْفَزَ (iḥranfaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
